name: ridemitra
description: Responsive carpooling and bikepooling platform for city and intercity commuting

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@ridemitra/shared && npm run build --workspace=@ridemitra/api && npm run build --workspace=@ridemitra/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@ridemitra/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@ridemitra/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@ridemitra/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@ridemitra/api && npm run test --workspace=@ridemitra/web
